searchText: May we have an invitation to the call or announce it 12 hours before next time? <@!187490121698770945> ^^ Hey all, so I tried something new and used machine translation for this call. Let me know if you think it's a bad idea. The benefit is that the transcript has timestamps, so you can get the video link if you really want to review what was said, and of course by outsourcing to neural networks outside of my own skull I saved quite a bit of time and headache meticulously transcribing 90 minutes of conversation... https://notes.ethereum.org/@afhGjrKfTKmksTOtqhB9RQ/HkIjiJKUL I did still run through it once to make sure technical terms are correctly transcribed A quick scan looks like it's "good enough". 👍 Anyone who needs the exact wording can watch the video and for what it's worth, the previous transcrips are much cleaner precisely because they don't do exact wording. People talk really funny when it's transcribed word for word... <@!425572898787426305> DM your email and I'll add you to the Call invite. And yes, I can send reminders in this channel the day before the call. done! ty!
